title: Links -lrt
message: There is no librt in the QNX 8.0 SDP: linking with -lrt fails ('cannot find -lrt', SDP 8.0 build 141, x86_64 and aarch64le). The POSIX realtime functions live in libc.
remedy: Drop -lrt on QNX (conditional on the platform), or detect with check_library_exists / AC_SEARCH_LIBS so a missing library is not fatal.
verify: Verified on SDP 8.0 build 141: ld cannot find -lrt.

title: Links -lpthread
message: There is no libpthread in the QNX 8.0 SDP: linking with -lpthread fails ('cannot find -lpthread', SDP 8.0 build 141). pthreads are in libc. (-pthread as a compiler flag is accepted by qcc.)
remedy: Use find_package(Threads) + Threads::Threads in CMake, or make the flag conditional on the platform; the compiler flag -pthread links fine.

title: Links -ldl
message: There is no libdl in the QNX 8.0 SDP: linking with -ldl fails ('cannot find -ldl', SDP 8.0 build 141). dlopen/dlsym are in libc.
remedy: Use ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} in CMake (empty where unneeded), or conditionalise -ldl.

title: Links Linux/glibc helper libraries (-lnsl -lresolv -lanl -lutil)
message: libnsl, libutil, libresolv, libcrypt and libanl do not exist in the QNX 8.0 SDP (-lX fails with 'cannot find', SDP 8.0 build 141). Socket code needs -lsocket instead (libsocket exists and links).
remedy: Remove these, or detect per platform. Networking on QNX needs -lsocket (add it explicitly when linking socket code: accept4, getaddrinfo, sendmsg, getifaddrs and others do not link without it in SDP 8.0 build 141). crypt() is declared in <login.h> but no library exports it.

title: Compiler hard-coded to gcc/clang instead of qcc
message: QNX software is built with the SDP compiler drivers (qcc for C, q++ for C++), selected with -V<variant>, not the host gcc.
remedy: Do not hard-code the compiler; let the caller set CC/CXX (CC=qcc -Vgcc_ntoaarch64le after sourcing qnxsdp-env.sh) or supply a CMake toolchain file.

title: -pie / -fPIE flags
message: Position-independent executable flags: on SDP 8.0 build 141 qcc accepts -fPIE, -pie and -no-pie; -static-pie is rejected (link fails) on at least one of the two targets.
remedy: Keep them behind a platform check until confirmed with the target toolchain.
verify: Flag result from qcc link probes on SDP 8.0 build 141.

title: -fPIC flag
message: -fPIC is accepted by qcc (SDP 8.0 build 141, both targets). Listed so it is checked once on the real toolchain; now it has been.
remedy: Nothing to change unless qcc rejects it; for CMake prefer CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE.

title: GNU-ld specific linker flags
message: Linker options that depend on the GNU/Linux linker setup. On SDP 8.0 build 141 qcc accepts --no-undefined, -z defs, --as-needed, -z relro/now/noexecstack, --gc-sections, -soname, --hash-style=gnu, -rpath, --export-dynamic and --build-id for a trivial link; behaviour on a real shared library was not tested.
remedy: The flags link a trivial program under qcc, so keep them unless a real link fails; test shared-library builds on the target toolchain.
verify: Flag results from qcc link probes on SDP 8.0 build 141 (trivial program only).

title: Sanitizer flags
message: Sanitizers on SDP 8.0 build 141: -fsanitize=undefined and =leak link; =address and =thread are rejected by qcc (libasan exists in the SDP lib dir but the driver rejects the flag in this probe).
remedy: Keep sanitizer builds as host-only (Linux) test configurations, or use -fsanitize=undefined where supported.
verify: Flag results from qcc link probes on SDP 8.0 build 141.

title: -march=native / -mtune=native
message: 'native' targets the build host's CPU. qcc/gcc rejects -march=native for cross builds on SDP 8.0 build 141 (probe: absent); -mtune/-mcpu=native differ per target. Wrong when cross-compiling anyway.
remedy: Remove, or select the target CPU explicitly per QNX variant.
verify: Flag results from qcc probes on SDP 8.0 build 141.

title: CMake logic keyed on Linux
message: A branch or setting assumes Linux. CMake identifies a QNX target as CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME 'QNX'.
remedy: Add a QNX branch (if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "QNX")), or generalise to if(UNIX) where the logic is POSIX-generic. In a toolchain file set CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME to QNX, not Linux.
refs: CMake docs: CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME (QNX is a documented value)

title: CMake project has no QNX toolchain/platform support
message: No file in this tree mentions QNX. Cross-building for QNX with CMake needs a toolchain file.
remedy: Provide a toolchain file: CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME QNX, CMAKE_C_COMPILER/CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER set to qcc/q++ with the -V variant (for example gcc_ntoaarch64le), roots from QNX_HOST/QNX_TARGET after sourcing qnxsdp-env.sh; run cmake -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=...
verify: verify against SDP: variant names and the toolchain file template shipped with the SDP.

title: Autotools project with no QNX host support
message: No QNX mention in the tree. Old bundled config.sub/config.guess may not recognise a QNX host triplet.
remedy: Refresh config.sub/config.guess (autoreconf -fi or copy from a current automake), then configure with --host=<cpu>-unknown-nto-qnx<version> and CC set to qcc.
verify: verify against SDP: exact host triplet format for 8.0.

title: configure.ac switches on a Linux host triplet
message: Host-OS detection matches Linux only; a QNX host triplet (…-nto-qnx…) falls through to the default branch.
remedy: Add an *nto-qnx* case with the QNX libs/flags, and make the default branch safe.

title: Makefile branches on uname
message: Platform is taken from the build host. When cross-compiling the host is Linux/macOS while the target is QNX; uname on a QNX host reports QNX.
remedy: Key the logic on a target variable (for example TARGET_OS passed on the command line) rather than uname of the build machine.

title: Host system paths in flags
message: Absolute host paths pull host (Linux) headers and libraries into a cross build; QNX builds use the SDP sysroot ($QNX_TARGET).
remedy: Use sysroot-relative paths or variables set by the toolchain; let qcc find its own system directories.
